description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's merge functionality, simulating various merge scenarios and conflicts in a Git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files to expected results.

methods.name: test_oid_cache
methods.description: Sets or verifies object ID cache.

methods.name: test_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID for a given git object.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Pauses briefly to ensure different timestamps.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
